closed_gaps: A8PersistentCatalog now uses the D-014 SqliteDatabase seam with a version marker, structured Session/Goal/Turn/Task/Run/fact tables and bounded SHA-256 checked summaries.
Desktop Host hydrates durable sessions and task projections, persists task/run transitions, Review file hash metadata and Validation summaries, and never auto-resumes execution.
Restored Review projections use the private staging root and re-check every target baseline before allowing an explicit user action; drift becomes STALE and Apply remains blocked.
Recovery is fail-closed for future schema, malformed JSON, hash drift, sequence/reference corruption and missing Review references; only executing states are atomically marked INTERRUPTED.
A7 migration is explicit and idempotent: only workspace/settings allowlists are imported; credentials, WAL/SHM, temporary and Runner data are excluded; marker/report writes are fsync/atomic.
No new runtime, dependency, command, network target, Terminal input or Browser capability was introduced.
